description: Crash survival, WebKit arm (F12): SIGKILL the WebContent process of a WebKit tab and of an agent page (pids the app reports, each proved the app's by its responsible process), the WebKit tab beside a terminal that is typed into. survived/cases per launch (a case it could not measure counts as not survived; .measured says how many were), the kill to the page answering again, and terminal key->frame after the tab's kill.
